view: Frontal chest radiograph (PA/AP, L marker at image top right = patient's left; scapulae overlie upper lateral lung fields)
technical_quality: Adequate inspiration (about 9 posterior ribs), acceptable penetration, minimal rotation; scapulae not fully cleared from the lung fields, slight collimation cut-off at the film edges

devices.type: Implanted subcutaneous chest port (dual-lumen reservoir appearance, two round chambers with a stem)
devices.location: left upper anterior chest wall, projecting over the left upper zone at about the anterior 2nd-3rd rib; catheter course to the central veins not clearly traced

abnormalities.finding: Lobulated, clustered nodular opacity in the left hilar/perihilar region, bulky left hilum (lymphadenopathy or hilar mass), approx 3-4 cm
Prominent, unfolded/tortuous aortic knob with slight widening of the left superior mediastinal contour
Coarse bronchovascular / reticular interstitial markings in the lower zones, more on the right, without frank consolidation
Implanted chest port device overlying the left upper zone (foreign body / device, not lung pathology)
Mild bilateral apical pleural thickening / capping

description_zh: 胸部正面X光，吸氣深度足夠，曝露適當，兩側肩胛骨部分重疊於肺野。左上胸壁見一植入式人工血管注射座（雙腔式外觀），導管走向未能清楚追蹤；未見胸管或引流管。左側肺門區可見分葉狀、聚集性結節狀陰影，左肺門增大，需考慮肺門淋巴結腫大或肺門腫塊；主動脈弓突出且迂曲，左上縱膈輪廓略寬。兩下肺野支氣管血管紋理粗糙增加（右側較明顯），未見明確實質化、氣胸或肋膜積液，兩側肋膈角銳利；心臟大小在正常上限，骨骼未見明顯異常。
